name: compress x lottery-band
evidence: combines inequality-compression x lottery-bucketing; super-additive +0.023; removes the fuel (skill premium) AND the target (buyable rank)

name: in-kind x permanence
evidence: combines in-kind services x credible-permanence; super-additive +0.000; a constitutionally-locked in-kind childcare guarantee - form x durability

name: universal+statefund x de-risk
evidence: combines universal-penalty-removal x state-funding x de-risk; super-additive +0.000; universal state-funded leave with a job guarantee

name: coupling-afford x housing-supply
evidence: combines coupling-affordability x housing-supply; super-additive +0.005; couple-targeted family housing via supply (3bed+ ~2.3x births/euro)

name: de-risk x school-ed x peer
evidence: combines de-risk-dissolution x school-education x peer-contagion; super-additive +0.050; PREP delivered bottom-up as a peer norm - contagion multiplies uptake

name: IVF-default x egg-banking x permanence
evidence: insure the biological runway but the egg-freezing option-trap caps it - optimum is low reliance (H153)

name: gender-eq x father-quota x short-hrs
evidence: combines gender-equity x father-quota x decouple-overwork; super-additive +0.030; the second-shift stack - equalise the domestic load

name: inequality-compression x fertility-linked-pension
evidence: the pension corrective has thin causal support (H152) so compression dominates the blend

name: pension-fertility externality
evidence: Boldrin-De Nardi-Jones: pension=10% GDP <-> -0.7..-1.6 TFR gross (55-65% of the US-EU gap); a fertility-linked pension internalises it but enacted-credit effects are small - thin causal support

name: UBI vs child-conditional transfer
evidence: Alaska PFD +13.1% fertility (strongest for disadvantaged) but tempo; unconditionality adds NO premium over child-conditional - response tracks cash size + liquidity, not the absence of conditions

name: employment-precarity formation-brake
evidence: Alderotti meta-analysis: temporary contracts cut births (esp. 2nd), effect strengthening over time; security pulls formation earlier (rho down); Korea +2.5pp (tempo caveat)

name: egg-freezing option-value trap
evidence: return-to-use ~5.7%, unconditional live-birth ~1.6%; the option value licenses postponement that costs more births than it delivers - insure the runway, don't postpone (no RCT yet, inferred)

name: fecundity floor (sub-fecundity)
evidence: a 3-4yr delay costs only ~0.1-0.2 children biologically; obesity -3%/BMI-unit is the best-evidenced piece, age wall steep after 37; sperm-count/EDC narratives contested - a hard wall but a minority cause

name: hypergamy marriage-squeeze
evidence: women out-educate men in 139+ countries; Korea hypergamous marriages 22%->11%; bites via the marriage margin (East Asia), norm already eroding on its own, confounded with the second-shift

name: one-child-policy hysteresis
evidence: China TFR FELL 1.67(2015)->1.09(2022) AFTER lifting the policy; RDD - only-child status durably lowers ideal family size; norms + cost structures lock in below the policy (you can't un-ring the bell)

name: grandmother hypothesis (kin proximity)
evidence: grandmother >=200km away <-> ~1 fewer child; daily care 30% IT/ES vs 2% Nordic; loads on the 2nd birth; endogeneity (move near kin) + substitutes weak formal childcare; Korea +2.4pp

name: climate/expectations birth-strike
evidence: 20-33% cite climate; behaviourally real but only among committed environmentalists (minority) via the childless-forgoing margin; optimism can't be engineered top-down - propaganda backfires (Decree 770)

name: migrant-fertility assimilation convergence
evidence: gen-2 fertility often BELOW natives; full convergence >1 generation (Turkish-origin the slow outlier); migration is a one-time level boost per cohort, sustained only by continuous inflow - a bridge, not a cure

name: urban-density fertility penalty
evidence: apartment cores ~TFR 1.0 vs family suburbs ~2.0; mechanism is housing space/type not density per se; heavy self-selection, no natural experiment - flagged low-confidence

name: status-of-parenthood reversal
evidence: make parenthood a positional/high-status good again; bottom-up peer contagion works, top-down status engineering backfires like propaganda (span G) - peer-led only
